answer_1.quote: Among natural language processing (NLP) tasks, the automatic generation of a long-form story is a representative task that requires creativity and long-term planning skills.

answer_2.quote: We apply the auto evaluation metrics including n-gram entropy and set n = 2 (Ent-2) to evaluate the degree of content repetition... Besides, we apply our proposed conflict rate (CR.) to evaluate the contextual consistency.

answer_3.quote: Since LLM-as-a-judge has been verified by experiments and it can evaluate some features of a text within a certain length according to rules, we apply LLM to further detect the conflict quadruples based on time order.

answer_4.quote: To evaluate the alignment of the stories with human preferences... we further conduct a human evaluation to evaluate the story quality of plot completeness, coherence, relevance, interest level, and expression coherence.
answer_4.guideline: Human evaluators rank stories based on metrics: plot completeness, coherence, relevance, interest level, and expression coherence.
